newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Southern Africa hotel groups in strategic alliance.
newsitem.headline: Southern Africa hotel groups in strategic alliance.

text.p: South African Breweries Ltd's, Southern Sun Group and Zimbabwe Sun have formed a strategic alliance to jointly develop and market key tourist destinations in the region.

As part of the agreement, Southern Sun will help convert the Elephant Hills Hotel at Victoria Falls into a five-star Inter-Continental resort to be known as the Elephant Hills Inter-Continental Victoria Falls.
It will also provide technical support at the recently refurbished Victoria Falls Hotel, which will not take on the Inter-Continental name.
The two groups plan to start working together in October and the conversion of the Elephant Hills Hotel should be completed by early next year.

Southern Sun chief operating executive Helder Pereira told Reuters further development at Victoria Falls would depend on an environmental impact study now underway, but that his group was also considering development opportunities on the Zambian side of the falls.
